reviews.text: We loved working with Salva. We have a miniature poodle, Dorito, who thinks he's the king of the jungle, and little by little we've been calming him down. We've come to understand why Dorito is the way he is, and with the training, we now have the necessary tools to manage him. 100% recommended. It's well worth it.
We've gone from having a stressed dog to a calm, relaxed podenco! Many thanks to Salva and his excellent work ethic, highly recommended!!
Very professional! We have done a couple of courses with him (both individually and in a group with other dogs) and the truth is that they have been very beneficial :)

An incredible experience. Salva is a fantastic instructor! The course is very well organized, fun, and perfect for enjoying with your dog while learning to forage for saffron milk cap mushrooms in the great outdoors.

Lola, our dog, although fun and affectionate, became aggressive whenever strangers came to our house. The sound of the doorbell triggered her anxiety, and we didn't know how to control her. Thanks to Salva, we've learned to manage the situation and apply what he's taught us in any circumstance. Thank you, Salva!

We didn't even take the dog for a walk, just a notebook and making ourselves look useless. They showed videos of monkeys with dogs and said that if they could do it, why couldn't we? But they still took the 300-plus euros 😃 and in my opinion, anyone who has the opportunity not to spend that money shouldn't. …

We are very happy with the results of the training; it has helped Teddy a lot. He's a completely different dog since he started. He's much more balanced, and his barking has improved tremendously. Salva was very attentive and explained things perfectly so we could do it the right way. We recommend him 100%.

Highly recommended! Salva has helped us tremendously to understand our dog and how to interact with him in our daily lives. We noticed changes from the very first classes. He's also always incredibly helpful with any questions outside of class. A 10 out of 10!

Salva is an excellent trainer. We have Wasabi, who is a somewhat difficult dog, easily frightened and prone to pulling on the leash during walks. With certain exercises and by taking away his toys, he improved considerably! Although we weren't very consistent, today Wasabi goes out on his own on a single leash without needing another leash attached to his harness. The talks he gives during the first two classes are also very interesting. Thank you so much from the whole family.

We called Salva when Mia was just a 5-month-old puppy. She was stressed, and we didn't know how to manage her instincts (she was destroying the house). Salva taught us techniques and gave us guidelines to follow for a couple of months so that we could have a better relationship with her, both for her and for us. To this day, when things go wrong or the dog has stressful moments, we go back to his advice, and I can only thank him and recommend him to everyone I meet. Thank you so much, Salva!
